name: Call to Arms
description: (Tag:summon)(Gacha) Call to Arms rolls the familiar gacha to temporarily grant you a familiar fighting by your side for 1 hour, then it disappears. At 1 Ability Slot you pull Bronze, 2 slots = Silver, 3 slots = Gold, 4 Slots = Platinum, capping at 5 slots = Diamond. 24 Hour cooldown.
